description.en:
A2 Ultra is AgiBot's humanoid platform for interactive commercial services and application development. Its advertised capabilities combine visual perception, spoken interaction and autonomous navigation, allowing it to engage visitors while moving through a configured environment. The interaction system supports customized knowledge, wake words, voices and skills, including integration with enterprise language-model services.

The product is positioned for reception, guided presentations and other activities that combine information delivery with physical presence. AgiBot also describes obstacle avoidance and coordinated operation of multiple units. Deployment requires configuring the robot's knowledge, environment and task behavior for the intended site rather than relying on an identical setup for every customer.
